def as_pose(xyz):
    return np.r_[np.asarray(xyz, dtype=np.float32), Q_DOWN]

def poly_rows(a, b, spacing):
    a = np.asarray(a, float); b = np.asarray(b, float)
    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(np.linalg.norm(b-a)/spacing)))
    return np.stack([as_pose(a + (b-a)*(i/n)) for i in range(1,n+1)])

class Painter:
    def __init__(self):
        self.r = Robot()
        now = np.asarray(self.r.get_obs(cameras=('side_cam',), video='none').meta['proprio']['now'][7:10], float)
        self.cmd = now.copy()
        self.q = Q_DOWN
        print('connected; actual tip', now, 'time left', self.r.get_obs(cameras=('side_cam',),video='none').meta.get('time_left_s'))

    def send(self, arr, label, video='none', cameras=('side_cam',)):
        res = self.r.submit('ee_pose', np.asarray(arr, np.float32), dt=.05, video=video,
                            cameras=cameras, note=label)
        plan = res.meta.get('plan', [])
        fails = sum(int(p.get('ik_failures',0)) for p in plan)
        slow = sum(int(bool(p.get('slowed'))) for p in plan)
        if len(arr): self.cmd = np.asarray(arr[-1,:3], float)
        actual = res.proprio[-1,7:10].copy() if res.proprio is not None and len(res.proprio) else None
        print(label, 'rows',len(arr),'IK fails',fails,'slowed',slow,'target',self.cmd.round(4),'actual',None if actual is None else actual.round(4))
        return res

    def move(self, xyz, label, spacing=.006):
        arr=poly_rows(self.cmd, xyz, spacing)
        return self.send(arr,label)

    def hold(self, xyz, seconds, label):
        arr=np.repeat(as_pose(xyz)[None,:], max(1,int(round(seconds*20))),axis=0)
        return self.send(arr,label)

    def dip(self, label):
        self.move(INK, label+'_over_stone')
        self.move([-.100,.150,.023], label+'_dip', spacing=.0025)
        self.hold([-.100,.150,.023],.5,label+'_soak')
        self.move([-.100,.150,.075], label+'_lift', spacing=.0025)

    @staticmethod
    def paper_xy(uv):
        u,v=uv
        # Image row 0 is the far sheet edge; columns increase toward the robot's right.
        x=.0135925-(float(v)+.5)*MM/1000.
        y=.1135925-(float(u)+.5)*MM/1000.
        return np.array([x,y],float)

    @staticmethod
    def smooth_pixels(points, samples_per_segment=12):
        p=np.asarray(points,float); out=[]
        # Catmull-Rom interpolation, with extrapolated endpoint controls.
        for i in range(len(p)-1):
            p1,p2=p[i],p[i+1]
            p0=p[i-1] if i>0 else p1+(p1-p2)
            p3=p[i+2] if i+2<len(p) else p2+(p2-p1)
            for j in range(samples_per_segment):
                t=j/samples_per_segment; t2=t*t; t3=t2*t
                z=.5*((2*p1)+(-p0+p2)*t+(2*p0-5*p1+4*p2-p3)*t2+(-p0+3*p1-3*p2+p3)*t3)
                out.append(z)
        out.append(p[-1]); return np.asarray(out)

    def curve_pixels(self, points, z, label, spacing=.0014):
        dense=self.smooth_pixels(points)
        xy=np.array([self.paper_xy(p) for p in dense])
        ds=np.linalg.norm(np.diff(xy,axis=0),axis=1)
        arc=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(ds)]
        n=max(1,int(np.ceil(arc[-1]/spacing)))
        # Uniform physical distance samples keep commanded speed stable at the 20 Hz rate.
        d=np.linspace(0,arc[-1],n+1)[1:]
        path=np.column_stack([np.interp(d,arc,xy[:,k]) for k in range(2)])
        xyz=np.column_stack([path,np.full(len(path),float(z))])
        return self.send(np.stack([as_pose(x) for x in xyz]),label)

    def draw(self, i):
        label=f'stroke_{i+1}'
        points=STROKES[i]; start=self.paper_xy(points[0]); end=self.paper_xy(points[-1])
        self.dip(label)
        self.move([start[0],start[1],.075],label+'_to_start')
        self.hold([start[0],start[1],.075],.35,label+'_settle')
        self.move([start[0],start[1],PRESS_Z[i]],label+'_touch',spacing=.0025)
        self.curve_pixels(points,PRESS_Z[i],label+'_draw')
        self.move([end[0],end[1],.075],label+'_lift',spacing=.0025)

    def park_at_ink(self):
        self.move(INK,'inspection_park')
        self.hold(INK,.4,'inspection_settle')
        obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','side_cam','scene_cam'),video='none')
        for name,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/after_stroke1_'+name+'.png')
        print('saved first-stroke inspection; time left',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))

    def run(self,phase):
        if phase in ('main1','full'):
            self.draw(0)
            self.park_at_ink()
        if phase in ('rest','full'):
            begin=1 if phase=='rest' else 1
            for i in range(begin,9): self.draw(i)
        if phase=='all':
            for i in range(9): self.draw(i)
        if phase in ('rest','full','all'):
            obs=self.r.get_obs(cameras=('canvas_cam','side_cam','scene_cam'),video='none')
            for name,im in obs.last.items(): Image.fromarray(im).save('/app/output/final_'+name+'.png')
            print('final time left',obs.meta.get('time_left_s'))

if __name__=='__main__':
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser(); ap.add_argument('--phase',choices=['main1','rest','full','all'],default='full')
    args=ap.parse_args(); Painter().run(args.phase)
